data.title: US, Iran Agree on Further Truce Pending Signoff, Source Says
data.description: Iran and the US have reached a tentative deal to extend a ceasefire and work toward an agreement to end the war, a US source familiar with the matter said, raising hopes the three-month conflict could be nearing a resolution.
